deliveries.drafted: The delivery note is drafted: check it, then validate it when the goods leave.

card.title: Deliveries
card.figures: On notes: {{onNotes}} of {{quantity}}, {{delivered}} of it delivered · left: {{left}}
card.hint: Each note invoiced carries the price and discount accepted on the quote: invoice the validated notes from the delivery notes list. A quote delivered by notes is no longer invoiced as a whole.

part.title: Quantities to deliver
part.help: Each line starts at what is left to deliver; enter 0 to leave it off this note.

invoice_deliveries.of_invoice: Hands over the goods of the invoice
invoice_deliveries.billed_already: The invoice already billed these goods and took them out of stock when it was issued: this note moves no stock and is not invoiced.
invoice_deliveries.figures: Billed: {{quantity}}, taken back by credit note: {{returned}} · on notes: {{onNotes}}, {{delivered}} of it delivered · left: {{left}}
invoice_deliveries.hint: The goods left stock when the invoice was issued: its notes only tell their handover to the customer, moving no stock and never invoiced.

errors.delivery_refused: This delivery note is refused: each quantity is at most what is left to deliver of its line, once its credit notes and other notes are taken off.
This delivery note is refused: each quantity is at most what is left to deliver of its line, and at least one line is left.
errors.delivery_whole: This quote is invoiced as a whole: it carries a discount on the total or a deposit. Invoice it, then deliver from the invoice.
